title: Print Bibliography References Table
description: Generalize biblatex citation support from kompaktbericht-only hack into shared semio.cls, make citation style configurable per document, and render bibliography as chrome-styled references table in appendix/registers section.
summary: Generalized biblatex into semio.cls with configurable citestyle option (numeric default; alphabetic for paper; authoryear for kompaktbericht). Added SemioReferencesTitle, reference kind labels, SemioTableReference/SemioTableReferenceRow, and collect-then-render bibliography table in semio-window.sty wired into makeregisters. Updated all six templates with references.bib, citations, and registers (flyer keeps capability only). Fixed print/script.ts TEXINPUTS recursive search and biblatex reruns. Verified all 12 PDFs (6 templates × light/dark) via bun ./script.ts test.
